detailedServices.title: Complete Watch Servicing
detailedServices.description: Over time, fine lubricants within a watch movement age, thicken, or migrate, creating friction across pivots and gear teeth. Our complete watch service begins with the careful uncasing of the movement and separation of the dial and hands. Every component of the calibre is disassembled and cleaned in specialized ultrasonic solutions before being inspected under high magnification.
detailedServices.secondaryDescription: During reassembly, worn components are addressed, and multiple grades of horological oils and greases are applied in exact micro-quantities to each friction point. Finally, the movement is regulated across multiple positions and cased with fresh gaskets.
highlights: Complete movement disassembly and ultrasonic chemical bathing
Micro-lubrication of jewels, pivots, mainspring, and escapement
Multi-position timing regulation and amplitude assessment
Case cleaning, gasket inspection, and final quality verification

detailedServices.title: Mechanical Watch Servicing
detailedServices.description: Manual-wind and automatic mechanical watches rely on the delicate harmony of hundreds of interlocking parts—from the mainspring barrel and gear train to the escapement and oscillating balance wheel. Our mechanical servicing honours traditional watchmaking discipline, treating every bridge, screw, and jewel with unhurried precision.
detailedServices.secondaryDescription: For automatic movements, we pay particular attention to the reversing wheels, rotor axle, and winding efficiency so the timepiece maintains a dependable power reserve during daily wear.
highlights: Manual-wind and self-winding automatic calibre overhaul
Mainspring tension, barrel arbor, and winding mechanism care
Balance wheel poise, hairspring centring, and beat-error correction
Power reserve and winding efficiency verification

detailedServices.title: Quartz Watch Servicing
detailedServices.description: Modern and vintage quartz watches combine an electronic oscillator with a finely engineered mechanical gear train. Beyond simple battery changes, quartz calibres require periodic servicing to clean dried lubricants from the wheel train that can otherwise increase current draw and shorten battery life.
detailedServices.secondaryDescription: We test circuit board resistance, coil continuity, and stepping motor impulse strength while thoroughly servicing the mechanical wheels, setting lever, and keyless works.
highlights: Electronic module consumption and lower-working-voltage diagnostics
Cleaning and lubrication of the mechanical reduction gear train
Battery contact remediation and corrosion removal
Quartz oscillator frequency and accuracy verification

detailedServices.title: Battery Replacement
detailedServices.description: An improperly changed battery can scratch a caseback, deform a gasket, or leave fingerprints on delicate movement plates. At Asian Times, every battery replacement is performed at the watchmaker's bench using proper case-opening dies, insulated tweezers, and high-grade silver-oxide or lithium cells matched to the movement specification.
detailedServices.secondaryDescription: Before closing the watch, we inspect the battery compartment for any signs of past leakage, clean the caseback seating channel, and lubricate the sealing gasket.
highlights: Scratch-free case opening using movement-appropriate dies
High-grade cell installation with non-magnetic insulated tools
Current consumption check and contact terminal cleaning
Caseback gasket dressing and secure resealing

detailedServices.title: Strap and Bracelet Replacement
detailedServices.description: A timepiece should sit balanced and secure on the wrist. Whether you wish to refresh your watch with a new leather strap, swap seasonal bands, or adjust the fit of a metal bracelet, we handle lugs and clasps with protective masking to prevent tool marks.
detailedServices.secondaryDescription: We replace fatigued spring bars, tighten worn bracelet screws or friction pins, and perform micro-adjustments at the clasp for effortless everyday comfort.
highlights: Precision link removal, addition, and micro-clasp sizing
Leather, rubber, and metal strap installation without lug scratches
Fresh stainless steel spring bars, tubes, and screw-pin replacement
Clasp closure alignment and deployment mechanism adjustment

detailedServices.title: Watch Cleaning
detailedServices.description: Mumbai's humidity, dust, and daily wear naturally accumulate between bracelet links, beneath bezels, and around the caseback. Left unchecked, trapped grit accelerates wear on metal pins and degrades rubber seals.
detailedServices.secondaryDescription: We separate the bracelet from the watch head—and, where needed, uncase the movement—so metal components can undergo deep ultrasonic cleaning, steam rinsing, and warm air drying before careful reassembly.
highlights: Ultrasonic cleaning of metal bracelets, clasps, and end-links
Gentle detailing of case recesses, bezel flutes, and crown guards
Removal of accumulated moisture, residue, and abrasive dust
Careful drying and inspection of all exterior fastening points

detailedServices.title: Water Resistance Checks
detailedServices.description: Water resistance is not a permanent property of a watch; rubber and synthetic gaskets dry out, flatten, and lose elasticity over time—particularly in warm climates. Checking seals regularly helps protect the dial and movement from moisture intrusion.
detailedServices.secondaryDescription: We inspect the caseback gasket, crown seal, and crystal seating, replacing aged O-rings and applying silicone gasket treatment to help preserve your timepiece against everyday moisture exposure.
highlights: Inspection of caseback, crown, pusher, and crystal seals
Replacement of compressed or degraded rubber O-ring gaskets
Silicone lubrication of sealing surfaces
Pressure and condensation risk assessment

detailedServices.title: Watch Polishing
detailedServices.description: Refinishing a watch case requires restraint and respect for original geometry. Over-polishing softens crisp lug bevels and alters the character of a timepiece. Our approach focuses on sympathetic surface restoration that revives lustre while preserving case lines.
detailedServices.secondaryDescription: We mask distinct textures carefully to maintain the contrast between mirror-polished chamfers and fine satin-brushed surfaces across the case and bracelet.
highlights: Restrained surface refinishing that respects original lug geometry
Careful separation of mirror-polished and satin-brushed finishes
Removal of surface swirl marks and light everyday scuffs
Post-polish ultrasonic bath to remove all polishing compounds

detailedServices.title: General Maintenance
detailedServices.description: Between full movement overhauls, periodic check-ups keep your timepiece performing reliably. If a watch begins running slightly fast or slow, feels stiff when winding, or has suffered an accidental knock, an early inspection prevents minor wear from becoming a major repair.
detailedServices.secondaryDescription: We perform demagnetization, timing checks, crown and stem inspections, dial and hand clearance verification, and general preventative adjustments.
highlights: Movement demagnetization and timegrapher rate evaluation
Crown winding feel, hand-setting, and date-change inspection
Crystal, bezel, and caseback security check
Honest guidance on whether immediate servicing is needed

repairs.title: Mechanical Watch Repairs
repairs.subtitle: Manual-Wind Calibres & Traditional Movements
repairs.description: From broken mainsprings and worn barrel teeth to damaged balance staffs and slipped setting levers, we diagnose and rectify mechanical faults with careful component-level attention. Each repair is followed by complete cleaning, lubrication, and positional regulation.
points: Mainspring replacement and barrel arbor alignment
Gear train pivot and jewel inspection
Escapement pallet fork and impulse adjustment
Hairspring truing and beat-error calibration

repairs.title: Automatic Watch Repairs
repairs.subtitle: Self-Winding Rotors & Power Reserve Systems
repairs.description: Self-winding watches depend on a finely balanced oscillating weight and delicate reversing wheels. When an automatic watch stops holding its charge or produces rotor noise, we inspect the rotor bearing, axle, reduction gears, and bridal mainspring attachment.
points: Oscillating weight axle and ball-bearing restoration
Reversing wheel and automatic winding bridge repair
Slipping-attachment mainspring and barrel wall care
Bidirectional and unidirectional winding verification

repairs.title: Quartz Watch Repairs
repairs.subtitle: Electronic Modules, Coils & Wheel Trains
repairs.description: When a quartz watch fails to run even with a fresh battery, the issue often lies in oxidized contacts, a damaged copper coil, a stalled stepping motor rotor, or a fouled mechanical wheel train. We isolate electronic and mechanical faults systematically.
points: Electronic circuit board and coil resistance diagnostics
Battery leakage neutralization and contact restoration
Stepping motor stator and magnetic rotor cleaning
Calendar mechanism and hand-setting train repair

repairs.title: Watch Movement Inspection
repairs.subtitle: Microscopic Assessment & Timegrapher Diagnostics
repairs.description: Every dependable repair begins with an accurate diagnosis. We examine the movement under magnification to check lubricant condition, end-shake, side-shake, jewel integrity, and acoustic timing metrics including rate, amplitude, and beat error.
points: Acoustic timing analysis across multiple dial and crown positions
Visual inspection of jewel bearings, pivots, and screw slots
Detection of magnetization, moisture ingress, or impact damage
Clear, transparent explanation of findings before work begins

repairs.title: Crown and Stem Repairs
repairs.subtitle: Winding, Setting & Case Tube Integrity
repairs.description: As the primary mechanical interface between wearer and movement, the crown and winding stem endure constant stress. We repair stripped screw-down threads, bent or rusted winding stems, loose crowns, and worn keyless works components.
points: Winding stem replacement and precision length trimming
Crown gasket and case tube thread restoration
Keyless works—yoke, setting lever, and clutch wheel—repair
Smooth winding and crisp hand-setting engagement

repairs.title: Bracelet and Clasp Repairs
repairs.subtitle: Structural Security & Deployment Mechanisms
repairs.description: A worn clasp or stretched bracelet pin puts the entire timepiece at risk of an accidental drop. We restore secure closure to folding clasps, butterfly deployants, safety catches, end-links, and worn link pins.
points: Folding clasp tension adjustment and latch alignment
Replacement of worn friction pins, sleeves, and link screws
End-link seating and spring bar socket inspection
Push-button release and safety lock restoration

repairs.title: General Diagnostics
repairs.subtitle: Comprehensive Fault Finding & Horological Advice
repairs.description: Whether your timepiece has stopped unexpectedly, suffered a drop, developed condensation beneath the crystal, or exhibits misaligned hands and date wheels, our diagnostic evaluation identifies the root cause and outlines a practical path forward.
points: Root-cause analysis for sudden stoppage or erratic timekeeping
Dial feet, hand tension, and calendar disc alignment checks
Condensation and moisture damage triage
No-obligation consultation at our Lower Parel studio

faqs.question: How often should a watch be serviced?
faqs.answer: Most mechanical watches benefit from a complete inspection and service every few years, depending on how frequently the timepiece is worn and the climate conditions it encounters. Even if a watch appears to keep reasonable time, internal lubricants gradually dry out over time. For quartz watches, we recommend having the seals and movement checked whenever the battery is replaced, or sooner if you notice moisture or inconsistent timekeeping.

faqs.question: Do you service automatic watches?
faqs.answer: Yes. We service both manual-wind and self-winding (automatic) mechanical watches. Our care for automatic calibres includes complete disassembly of the movement and the automatic winding module, cleaning of the rotor bearing and reversing wheels, fresh micro-lubrication, and verification that the self-winding mechanism builds power smoothly.

faqs.question: Can I enquire about a specific watch repair?
faqs.answer: Certainly. Whether your watch has a loose crown, a broken strap or clasp, a stalled movement, misaligned hands, or simply needs a routine battery change, you can send us details via our contact form or directly on WhatsApp at +91 9819451443. Sharing the watch brand and the issue you are experiencing helps us guide you before you visit.

faqs.question: How do I request a service?
faqs.answer: You can initiate an enquiry using the online form on our Contact page—which formats your watch details directly into a WhatsApp message—or reach us directly at +91 9819451443 to arrange a visit to our location in Lower Parel, Mumbai. Once we inspect your timepiece in person, we explain the recommended work clearly before proceeding.

faqs.question: How long does servicing take?
faqs.answer: The time required depends on the nature of the work. Simple procedures such as battery replacements or strap adjustments are much quicker than a complete mechanical movement overhaul, which involves disassembly, cleaning, lubrication, and multi-day timing observation. After inspecting your watch, we provide a realistic timeframe tailored to the specific service required.
